name: Town of Bedford
gaps: No floor-area (FAR/GFA) limit for one-family homes in the Table of Dimensional Requirements; max_floor_area left null
Lot width is set as a minimum 'effective square' side (250/200/150/100/75 ft) rather than a frontage or width; recorded in notes, min_lot_width_ft left null
DH side yards are set by the Planning Board within 10-50 ft each / 20-100 ft total (table note 1); 10/20 recorded as the floor
EL and DH have no height in feet in the table (stories only); VA has no minimum lot area (3,500 sf per unit)
MF district appears in the table but not in the county layer, so it is not included; nonresidential districts not checked for one-family use (Schedule of Use Regulations PDF not retrieved)
Attachment is Supp 57 (Apr 2020); § 125-27 accessory rules were amended 9-16-2025 and are taken from the current HTML text

wetlands.summary: Ch. 122: wetlands/watercourses carry a 100 ft regulated buffer; most activities in a wetland or buffer need a Wetlands Control Commission permit (small sheds/decks/play sets over 50 ft from the wetland are exempt). § 125-14: max 25% of minimum lot area (50% in R-4A) may be wetland or under water.

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 102: Planning Board steep slope permit for any disturbance (clearing, grading, structures, driveways) on slopes of 25%+ (min 100 sf and 10 ft horizontal); ridgeline permit within 100 ft of mapped prominent ridgelines/hilltops.

trees.summary: Ch. 112: permit to remove any tree 18 in.+ dbh, landmark/special trees, DEC-protected native plants, trees over 8 in. within 150 ft of a designated scenic road's centerline, and trees in historic districts or conservation-development common land.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 103: stormwater management/SWPPP applies to land development activity disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan).

adu.summary: § 125-79: accessory apartment by Planning Board special permit in all residence districts, only inside an existing single-family house (5+ years old), 400-800 sf and max 25% of the house, owner-occupied, one per lot. § 125-79.1: cottages in existing accessory buildings in R-2A/R-4A.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings and structures (incl. pools, tennis courts, garages, sheds, generators/AC units) over 100 sf or 10 ft high need the principal yards and max 20 ft height; up to 100 sf and 10 ft may be at 1/3 of the side/rear yards but must meet the front yard (§ 125-27).
general.pools: Swimming pools are accessory structures under § 125-27: principal-building yards apply.
general.notes: Max exposed building elevation 40 ft in all residential districts. Aquifer Protection Zone (§ 125-29.4) overlays parts of town.

4A.name: R-4A Residence (4 acres)

max_building_coverage.note: All buildings and structures; tennis/paddle courts count at 50% (§ 125-27E)

max_impervious_coverage.note: Impervious surface: buildings plus porches, stairs, walkways, driveways, parking and other surfaces that do not absorb stormwater

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings/structures over 100 sf or 10 ft tall need the principal front/side/rear yards, max 20 ft high, ground floor max 0.5% of lot area (over 2,500 sf or 20 ft needs special permit); ones up to 100 sf and 10 ft may sit at 1/3 of the side and rear yards (§ 125-27C-D)

4A.source: § 125-50 Table of Dimensional Requirements - Residential (125 Attachment 5); §§ 125-13, 125-18, 125-27
4A.notes: Lot must also contain an effective square 250 ft on a side (§ 125-12B). 25 ft minimum frontage for new lots (§ 125-13B). Corner lots: street side yard equals the front yard (§ 125-18). Max exposed building elevation 40 ft (table note 2). Minimum dwelling cubage 14,000 cu ft.
